name: Rent a Girl
source:
You play as a shy university student in Tokyo who has always struggled to connect with others. After a humiliating experience exposes your social naivety, you find an unusual service: a girlfriend rental for social skills development.

What starts as a desperate attempt to overcome shyness turns into a journey of self-discovery, where "fake" relationships can reveal real truths about love, friendship, and personal growth.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3781460/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你扮演东京一名害羞的大学生，一直很难与他人建立联系。在一次羞辱性的经历暴露了你的社交天真之后，你发现了一项不寻常的服务：出租女友以培养社交技能。

一开始是为了克服害羞而绝望地尝试，后来却变成了自我发现的旅程，其中“虚假”的关系可以揭示关于爱情、友谊和个人成长的真实真相。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3781460/]Steam[/url]]
